info.description: The Meeting Participants Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about participants associated with specific meetings. This operation allows businesses to manage attendance, enhance collaboration, and streamline communication in meeting scenarios. Typical consumers include event coordinators, administrative users, and project managers seeking to keep track of participant engagement. By utilizing this API, users can efficiently retrieve a list of meeting participants to support analytics and reporting needs.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of participants for meetings.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch information about participants associated with meetings. It provides details such as their names, roles, and statuses, facilitating better management and understanding of meeting dynamics.
